build_actquantizer: build a per-token activation quantizer with configurable bits, groupsize, and symmetric or asymmetric mode
build_weightquantizer: build a weight quantizer with per-channel or groupwise quantization and optional MSE-based shrink optimization
build_actquantwrapper: build an activation quantization wrapper for linear layers with optional Hadamard rotation before quantization
use_stequantize: use the straight-through estimator autograd function to quantize tensors while preserving gradients during backprop
use_addactquant: use add_actquant to recursively wrap all linear layers in a model with ActQuantWrapper modules
